changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud DDoS Native Protection (Anti-DDoS Origin) intercept query skill.

- Enables query and troubleshooting of network-layer intercept records via aliyun CLI (ddosbgp / antiddos-public).
- Analyzes intercept modules, including blacklist, port blocking, geo-blocking, source rate limiting, fingerprint filtering, and default policy mechanisms.
- Maps each intercept record to its originating policy (custom or default, IP-specific or port-specific).
- Strictly read-only: skill refuses all write/modification operations per explicit refusal template.
- Covers scenario-based queries, IP block investigation, policy lookup, false positive diagnosis, and protection pack info retrieval.
summary: Alibaba Cloud scenario-based skill. Query and troubleshoot Alibaba Cloud DDoS Native Protection (Anti-DDoS Origin) network-layer intercept records via aliyun...
